`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast_256
    wire [15:0] group_valid;
    wire [15:0] group_enable;
    wire [15:0] group_winner;
    wire [15:0] low_terms [3:0];
    genvar g, j;

    for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
        wire [15:0] x;
        wire [15:0] local_winner;
        wire [3:0] local_code;
        assign x = input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
        assign group_valid[g] = |x;
        if (g == 15) begin : top_group
            assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
        end else begin : lower_group
            assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
        end
        assign group_winner[g] = group_valid[g] & group_enable[g];

        for (j = 0; j < 16; j = j + 1) begin : bits_in_group
            if (j == 15) begin : top_bit
                assign local_winner[j] = x[j];
            end else begin : lower_bit
                assign local_winner[j] = x[j] & ~(|x[15:j+1]);
            end
            if (g == 0 && j == 0) begin : default_bit
                assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] = group_enable[g] & ~(|x[15:1]);
            end else begin : ordinary_bit
                assign output_unencoded[g*16+j] = group_enable[g] & local_winner[j];
            end
        end

        assign local_code[0] = |(local_winner & 16'hAAAA);
        assign local_code[1] = |(local_winner & 16'hCCCC);
        assign local_code[2] = |(local_winner & 16'hF0F0);
        assign local_code[3] = |(local_winner & 16'hFF00);
        for (j = 0; j < 4; j = j + 1) begin : code_terms
            assign low_terms[j][g] = local_code[j] & group_enable[g];
        end
    end

    assign output_valid = |group_valid;
    assign output_encoded[0] = |low_terms[0];
    assign output_encoded[1] = |low_terms[1];
    assign output_encoded[2] = |low_terms[2];
    assign output_encoded[3] = |low_terms[3];
    assign output_encoded[4] = |(group_winner & 16'hAAAA);
    assign output_encoded[5] = |(group_winner & 16'hCCCC);
    assign output_encoded[6] = |(group_winner & 16'hF0F0);
    assign output_encoded[7] = |(group_winner & 16'hFF00);
end else begin : generic_original
    wire [W-1:0] input_padded;
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
    wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
    assign input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
    genvar l, n;

    for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
        assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
        if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
        end else begin : msb
            assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
        end
    end

    for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
        for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
            assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                    stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                    {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                    {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
            end
        end
    end

    assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
    assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
end
endgenerate

endmodule
`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The baseline critical path passes through hierarchical priority selection and then encoded-to-one-hot decoding. This serializes two substantial logic cones and places significant load on shared encoded signals.",
  "rewrite": "Specialize the requested instance into sixteen 16-bit groups. Compute local winners and higher-group exclusion in parallel, and generate output_unencoded directly from those terms. Compute the encoded low nibble from masked local codes and the high nibble from group winners. Retain the original implementation for other parameter configurations.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce the 2.60 ns maximum arrival by eliminating the encode-then-decode path and replacing priority mux chains with reduction and masking logic. No mapped timing result is available; the actual improvement requires the specified synthesis and STA flow.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Local priority terms and group-exclusion reductions introduce some duplicated logic, while removing the global encoded-to-one-hot decoder. Area is expected to remain below the 8862.124480 um^2 cap, but mapped area, equivalence, and zero electrical violations have not been measured or certified.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For WIDTH=256 and LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0, the highest asserted input wins. All-zero input produces output_valid=0, output_encoded=0, and output_unencoded=256'b1, preserving the original nonzero default one-hot output. All ports, parameter declarations, widths, signedness, and generic-path truncations are retained. The implementation is purely combinational and uses no external dependencies."
}
